explication: Tautulli is a self-hosted Plex monitoring, analytics, and notification web application. The main workflow is Plex activity reaching the application, being monitored and recorded, then appearing in the web interface and optionally triggering notifications. The README also documents library and media details, user and sync views, history, and analytics. The source excerpts are limited, so several links below reflect documented capabilities rather than inspected call sites; the tree does not expose implementation paths for every documented feature.
